arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > tmp/t/cli.py <<'PYEOF'
import subprocess, sys, os, json
CAND = ['python3','/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py']
M = '/workspace/examples/manifest.json'
R = '/workspace/examples/responses.jsonl'
cases = [
 ([], 2), (['-h'],2), (['--help'],2), (['plan'],2), (['replay'],2), (['replay',M],2),
 (['unknown'],2), (['plan',M,'-h'],2), (['plan','-h',M],2), (['plan',M,'--help'],2),
 (['plan','--','--help'],2), (['replay','--',M,'-h'],2), (['replay',M,R,'--help'],2),
 (['plan','--help',M],2), (['-h','plan',M],2), (['plan',M],0), (['replay',M,R],0),
 (['plan','--',M],0), (['replay','--',M,R],0),
 (['plan',M,M],2), (['replay',M,R,R],2), (['plan','nonexistent.json'],2),
 (['replay',M,'nonexistent.jsonl'],2), (['plan','/workspace'],2), (['replay','/workspace',R],2),
 (['--','plan',M],0), (['PLAN',M],2), (['plan',M],0),
]
fails = []
for args, want in cases:
    r = subprocess.run(CAND+args, capture_output=True)
    ok = r.returncode == want and (want != 0 or (r.stdout and not r.stderr)) and (want == 0 or (not r.stdout and r.stderr))
    if not ok:
        fails.append((args, want, r.returncode, r.stdout[:60], r.stderr[:100]))
# same plan output whether -- is used
a = subprocess.run(CAND+['plan',M],capture_output=True).stdout
b = subprocess.run(CAND+['plan','--',M],capture_output=True).stdout
if a != b: fails.append(('-- equivalence',))
print('cli failures:', len(fails))
for f in fails: print(' ', f)
PYEOF
python3 tmp/t/cli.py
